assistant|book_recommendation: Recommended 'Dear Martin' by Nic Stone - a novel about a black teenager wrongly accused of a crime who writes letters to MLK Jr.
Recommended 'The Poet X' by Elizabeth Acevedo - a novel-in-verse about an Afro-Latina teenager finding her voice through slam poetry
Recommended 'Long Way Down' by Jason Reynolds - a novel about a teenager struggling with his brother's murder and cycle of violence
Recommended 'All American Boys' by Jason Reynolds and Brendan Kiely - a novel about two teenagers affected by a police brutality incident
Recommended 'The Sun is Also a Star' by Nicola Yoon - a novel about a Jamaican-American teenager falling in love with a Korean-American boy
Recommended 'The Night Circus' by Erin Morgenstern, narrated by Jim Dale, for great narration
Recommended 'The Power' by Naomi Alderman, narrated by Adjoa Andoh, for great narration
Recommended 'The Song of Achilles' by Madeline Miller, narrated by Frazer Douglas, for great narration
Recommended 'The First Fifteen Lives of Harry August' by Claire North, narrated by Peter Kenny, for great narration
assistant|author_recommendation: Recommended Jason Reynolds - writes about social justice, identity, and the black experience in YA literature
Recommended Nicola Yoon - novels explore identity, family, social justice, experiences of people of color
Recommended Renee Watson - novels like 'Piecing Me Together' and 'Betty Before X' explore experiences of black girls and women
Recommended Ibi Zoboi - novels like 'American Street' and 'Pride' explore Haitian-American teenager experiences
Recommended Dhonielle Clayton - novels like 'The Belles' and 'Shattered Midnight', lush fantasy/speculative fiction
Recommended Tomi Adeyemi - 'Children of Blood and Bone' blends African mythology, fantasy, social commentary
Recommended Sabaa Tahir - 'An Ember in the Ashes' blends ancient Roman-inspired world-building, fantasy, social commentary
Recommended Nnedi Okorafor - novels like 'Who Fears Death' and 'Binti' blend African culture, mythology, social commentary
assistant|audiobook_recommendation: Recommended 'The Hate U Give' audiobook narrated by Bahni Turpin for powerful, emotive performance
assistant|narrator_recommendation: Recommended narrator Juliet Stevenson - nuanced, emotive performances; narrated 'The Girl on the Train' and 'The Power'
Recommended narrator Scott Brick - distinctive voice; narrated 'The Da Vinci Code' and 'The Bourne Identity'
Recommended narrator George Guidall - veteran with over 1,000 audiobooks including 'The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo'
Recommended narrator Khristine Hvam - youthful energy; narrated 'The Hunger Games' and 'The Divergent' series
assistant|audiobook_platform_recommendat: Recommended audiobook platforms: Audible, Libro.fm, Scribd, and public libraries (OverDrive/Hoopla)
